lines.text: The psalmist asks the LORD, the Judge of the earth, to rise up and repay the proud.
The wicked crush the LORD's people, murder the fatherless, and say the God of Abraham pays no heed.
The One who formed the eye can see, and He knows that the thoughts of man are futile.
The man the LORD disciplines is blessed, and the LORD will not forsake His people.
The LORD has been the psalmist's stronghold and his shepherd, and He will destroy the wicked for their wickedness.
